decision_provenance.claim_limit: This is a deterministic replay of the checked-in DWAC controller/router contract over fresh repository evidence, not a hosted Developer Execution Runtime receipt.

observed_gap: The fresh-main bridge contains a finite bootstrap candidate catalog. Once fresh-main observation, persistent PTY and GitHub remote delivery are closed, the generic path reaches NO_ACTIONABLE_CANDIDATE even when the repository evidence ledger still contains explicit UNRESOLVED/PENDING/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED truth boundaries.

That finite observation horizon would stop the long-running North Star loop for lack of a hard-coded next feature, contradicting the requirement that DWAC re-observe code reality and choose new bottlenecks without a manually maintained roadmap.

Current main still records real residual boundaries, including DWAC_COGNITION_UNRESOLVED for native complex changesets; the historical DWAC North Star record also left language-aware semantic graph evolution open after browser, PTY and remote delivery closure.
changes: bridge/dwac_bridge.py now promotes explicit evidence-led truth boundaries into neutral BottleneckCandidate inputs only after the bootstrap candidate catalog is exhausted.
The bridge does not map any discovered candidate to a development mode; NorthStarSelfDevelopmentController ranks the candidates and FourDevelopmentModeRouter independently chooses the mode.
Candidate identifiers are deterministic hashes of evidence source plus boundary text, preserving traceability without inventing a product feature name.
Boundaries explicitly marked as user-machine/external/credential/paid blockers remain externally blocked and cannot silently become autonomous work.
The bridge exposes selected_problem alongside selected_bottleneck so opaque deterministic candidate ids remain auditable.

verification.scenario: all bootstrap capabilities closed; one internal UNRESOLVED boundary plus one PENDING_USER_MACHINE boundary
verification.selected_problem: DWAC native complex repository changes remain UNRESOLVED without a reliable machine changeset.

truth_boundaries: The promotion layer is intentionally conservative: only evidence text carrying explicit actionability markers such as UNRESOLVED, BLOCKED, PENDING, NOT_RUN, MISSING, CANNOT or NO CLAIM is promoted.
Truth-boundary promotion is a discovery mechanism, not proof that the promoted problem can be closed in the current environment.

The hosted Developer Execution Runtime and UPDIA provider both returned transient HTTP 502 during this cycle; no successful hosted DWAC execution receipt is claimed.
